2. **I-B4721 (California Bank & Trust):** Extensive damage, 2 trapped on roof, Leidesdorff St blocked. Send 1 helicopter (HELI-P27; air ETA 3.4m) for hoist rescue, plus 1 engine (SFFD-28; ETA 4.0m).
3. **I-B3457 (805 Clay St) & I-B5528 (Rincon Annex):** Active fire in collapsed I-B3457 (2 engines, ETA 3.9–4.2m) and 4 trapped at high-occupancy I-B5528 (2 engines from SFFD-35; ETA 2.6m).

**Other Routing & Uncertainty:**
- Engines & ambulances to remaining trapped sites **I-B4902** and **I-B4584**.
- Split 20 police across **I-B3301**, **I-B4721**, **I-CROWD-1** (~200 people), and **I-CROWD-2** (~160 people) to clear Waverly Pl, Leidesdorff St, California St, and Battery St.
- 57% of area is unscanned. Send 2nd helicopter to recon unverified **I-B4804** and **I-B4958** before committing heavy rescue. Request mutual-aid USAR and ladder trucks immediately.
